subject: Request: Marketplace co-sell discount exception for Acme Corp (AWS Marketplace)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Amy Tang <amy.tang@amazon.com>, Sarah Byrd <sarah.byrd@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Marketplace co-sell discount exception for Acme Corp (AWS Marketplace)

Hi team,

Quick summary: Acme (procurement contact Sarah Byrd cc'd) is ready to move forward with a Dedicated + priority support package via AWS Marketplace, but we need a marketplace listing discount and a short onboarding credit to make the economics work against a competing incumbent. High level: $450k first-year ARR (annualized), committed 12-month term, want to purchase through AWS Marketplace so AWS can co-sell and treat as a commercial offer.

Ask: Requesting Deal Desk approval for a 25% marketplace offer discount (off list) and a 3-month onboarding credit (applied as a purchase rebate/credit) that will be reflected in the marketplace offer. This would be an exception to our standard marketplace discount guidance.

Why the exception:
- Acme is a strategic target for our co-sell motion in manufacturing (large reference potential).
- They require Dedicated capacity + custom onboarding (extra operational costs).
- AWS co-sell motion is committed (Amy, can you confirm co-sell alignment/process?)

Attached: acme-pricing-proposal.xlsx (pricing breakdown), acme-onboarding-sow-draft.pdf (SOW stub).

Please advise next steps and what additional materials Deal Desk / Legal need. Lauren, can you flag any T&C concerns for the marketplace listing? Marissa, need your sign-off to proceed via AWS Marketplace and to register the exception if approved.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme-pricing-proposal.xlsx (xlsx, 73KB)]
[Attachment: acme-onboarding-sow-draft.pdf (pdf, 210KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Marketplace co-sell discount exception for Acme Corp (AWS Marketplace)

Rafael — thanks for the summary and attachments. A couple of things we need to evaluate before I can sign off:  

1) Margin impact: provide net margin after the proposed 25% marketplace discount + 3-month credit (line item in the spreadsheet).
2) Co-sell confirmation: need an explicit note from AWS that they will register and actively co-sell (Amy, can you confirm the co-sell commitment and expected classification?).
3) Comparable precedent: any prior marketplace exceptions for similar size/industry (if yes, include references).
4) Approval path: exceptions >20% need VP approval. What's the target timeline on signature?

Policy note: our standard marketplace offer guidance caps discounts at 20% for self-service offers; exceptions for co-sell+strategic reference can be considered up to 30% with VP approval and finance sign-off. Provide an updated pricing tab and a brief one-paragraph business justification.

If you can get the margin calc and the AWS confirmation today, I'll assemble the exception package and route to Stephanie for VP approval.

–Marissa
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

Adding the technical context that supports the concession request:

- Deployment complexity: Acme needs dedicated GPU pools across two regions with a custom VPC setup and KMS integration; expected onboarding is 6–8 weeks and requires SE time.
- Migration risk: We will absorb data transfer and initial KV cache tuning work; professional services hours are not billable under the standard onboarding in this deal.
- Priority support: They want the 24/7 white-glove SLA that maps to our 'Premium' support tier.

These increase our cost-to-serve in year one and justify a combination of discounted list price (marketplace) + onboarding credit. I've attached a short technical estimate.

Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

1) We need the exact marketplace offer URL and the final list price after discount so we can route the purchase through our internal card-of-record process.
2) Please send a DocuSign-ready SOW with the onboarding credit clearly called out so we can get legal review.
3) Can AWS confirm the co-sell support and any field registration steps we need to take on our side? Amy, appreciate any guidance.

Regards,

Subject: Approval: Acme marketplace concession (conditional)

Marissa / Rafael — reviewed the package and the business justification. Approve a 25% marketplace discount and a 3-month onboarding credit on the following conditions:

- Must be executed as an AWS Marketplace offer with the discounted list price reflected on the offer page.
- Acme must be registered in the AWS co-sell pipeline and AWS must confirm active field engagement (Amy or AWS Co-sell to provide confirmation email).
- SOW must include a milestone: signature + AWS registration within 14 days; credit applied after signature and completion of onboarding milestone #2.
- Finance to flag for marketplace payout exception and confirm net margin >= 28% after concessions.

Marissa — please route to Finance and Legal as part of the exception workflow and confirm the offer ID so I can track. Rafael — move forward with Acme and keep me in the loop on sign date.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, North America Sales
